policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 2 Jun close (1x4 3.88, 3x6 4.00, 6x9 4.24, 9x12 4.42 vs WIBOR 3M 3.86) price roughly 55bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 2 Jun (May CPI eased mainly on food; decisions stay data-dependent). PAP survey (1 Jun): a hold at 3.75% until Q3 2027; Glapiński (18 May): no commitments. May flash CPI 3.1% (29 May; 3.7% expected, -0.3% m/m on food); core 3.0% in April. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 15 June (extended 28 May).
policy.risk_text: May flash CPI 3.1% (3.7% expected) cut hike pricing sharply; the risks are the US-Iran memorandum failing (oil back above $100) and the end of the fuel package lifting CPI; long end: June supply (switch 3 Jun, sales 17 and 24 Jun) and a 6.5-7% deficit.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; EKF consensus (2 Jun): 6.9%; windfall-tax bill (75% of margins above the 2025 level +20%) in preparation; fuel package (VAT 8%, price caps, minimum excise) to 15 June (28 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~56% (MoF, 29 May) financed; budget accounts >PLN 200bn expected at end-May (Drop, 29 May); BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds (2 Jun). S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May) and its analyst calls the missing medium-term consolidation the key rating risk (26 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun; May CPI 3.1% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.5% y/y (second estimate). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 2 Jun: The MPC held (ref 3.75%) as expected; the statement notes May CPI eased mainly on food and keeps decisions data-dependent, with risk factors unchanged. Banks keep a no-change base case for 2026; ING: hike pricing cooled to ~+25bp for 2026, PKO: an October hike is still fully priced. EKF consensus: GG deficit 6.9% of GDP in 2026, debt ~70% in 2027. MRPiPS proposes a 3.7% minimum-wage rise. BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds. Abroad: euro-area May flash HICP 3.2% (core 2.5%, above forecasts) cemented a June ECB hike (95% priced); US JOLTS openings 7.6m; Rubio: an Iran deal possible within days, but no sanctions relief just for Hormuz; Trump cut some metal tariffs. Brent (Aug) ~$95, TTF EUR47.6; Bund 10Y 2.97%, UST10 4.45%; a June BoJ hike ~78% priced; Hungary Q1 GDP 1.7%.

calendar.plan_text: MoF June plan (29 May): one switch on 3 Jun (settles 8 Jun; buys back DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126, OK0127, PS0527) and sale auctions on 17 and 24 Jun (PLN 6-12bn each) in OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; no T-bills; ~56% of 2026 needs financed. 3 Jun switch offer (1 Jun): sells OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1034, DS0436 and NZ0936. BGK priced EUR 2bn of FPC bonds on 2 Jun; FPC switch on 18 Jun (buys back FPC0427).
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining June operations: 3 Jun (switch), 17 Jun, 24 Jun. Next MPC in July, with the NBP projection: a hold is expected.

core_text: Regime: talks stalled and Gulf clashes resumed - Brent back at ~$95-98; the NBP held at 3.75% on 2 Jun while FRAs price roughly 55bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the Fed is priced for a 2026 hike, the BoE is priced for hikes, the CNB is on hold and the MNB is on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 51bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 280bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 2 Jun close). EZ HICP 3.2%, core 2.5%; June ECB hike priced (2 Jun).
